_readme: Structured version of the handwritten Ratios & Molds notebook (transcribed Aug 12 2026).
Design goals: (1) every numeric field that was a dash '-' or marked unclear in the source is set to null, meaning 'value to be fed later' - fill these in once confirmed on the floor.

(2) 'components' arrays inside each ratio, and 'extra_parameters' objects inside each mold, exist so you can ADD new ingredients or ADD new custom fields (e.g. cycle_time_seconds, labor_hours, machine_id) at any time without restructuring the schema.
(3) Adding a new color/ratio variant or a new mold = just append a new object to the relevant array with a new *_id. Nothing else needs to change.
(4) 'wastani' = average/estimated output per 50kg bag of cement, used for planning yield. 'pcs_per_m2' = pieces needed to cover one square meter.

PRODUCTION CAPACITY MODEL (added 2026-09-25, confirmed by SwahziTech): VIBRO method (floor tiles, wall tiles, paving, curbstones) = many small molds, one casting cycle per mold per day (curing overnight) - so qty_of_molds for a product IS its maximum daily output in pieces, a hard ceiling. PRESS method (press-machine products) = the opposite: only ONE large mold per product, but it cycles repeatedly - 10-20 pcs per batch, many batches per day, totaling roughly 1000-8000 pcs and 50-200 bags of cement consumed per day depending on the product's ratio and working hours. Capacity here is a function of cycle speed x hours worked, NOT mold count. STEEL_RING_CAST (culverts) and STEEL_ROLLER_CAST (posts/bicons) capacity model not yet defined - flagged as open, do not assume the vibro rule applies to them.

capacity_model.description: One large mold per product. Output is cycle-speed x hours worked, not mold count.
capacity_model.note: 1000-8000 pcs/day is NOT a fixed plant-wide ceiling - confirmed by SwahziTech 2026-09-25 that it varies by which product is running and hours worked that day. The per-item 'estimated_daily_output_pcs_range' below (wastani_per_bag x bags/day) is the operative figure per product; the 1000-8000 range is just a general illustrative observation across the product mix, not a validation ceiling to flag items against.

_decisions_log.decision: Products can have many colors beyond what's printed. The catalog lists only the most common colors (OffWhite/Red/Grey); Black remains a valid, active ratio/product for floor and wall tiles.
_decisions_log.action_taken: Added catalog_featured flag per color ratio; no colors removed.

_decisions_log.topic: Ratio scope confirmed: shared per category, not per mold
_decisions_log.decision: All tile molds within a category (Floor Tiles, Wall Tiles, Paving) share the same cement:sand:chip:dawa:rangi ratio per color, regardless of mold/shape. Only the mold's yield (pcs_per_sqm, coverage) differs.
_decisions_log.action_taken: Confirms the ratio structure already used in this file. Resolved the '40 Halfmoon missing ratio' flag - it uses the standard floor_tiles ratios, added as mold #22.

_decisions_log.topic: pcs/sqm vs pcs/bag are distinct metrics - terminology fixed
_decisions_log.decision: pcs_per_sqm (or pieces_per_m2) = how many pieces are needed to cover one square meter (a coverage/density constant of the mold's physical size). wastani_per_bag = how many pieces are produced, on average, from one 50kg bag of cement (a production yield figure that also depends on the mix ratio). These were incorrectly merged into one free-text field for the press-machine paving items - split into two separate numeric fields, with pcs_per_sqm derived by division where both source numbers existed.
_decisions_log.action_taken: Fixed press_09a, press_09b, press_10 (both fields now populated). press_11/12/13 only had yield given in source, so pcs_per_sqm stays null for those - genuinely not derivable without a coverage figure.

_decisions_log.topic: Trench covers confirmed vibro; press daily-output range is per-product, not a fixed ceiling
_decisions_log.decision: Trench Covers uses the same vibro capacity model as Floor Tiles/Wall Tiles/Paving/Curbstones (qty_of_molds = max daily output pcs). The 1000-8000 pcs/day figure for press-machine products is not a uniform plant ceiling - it depends on which product is running and hours worked, so individual products (e.g. fast-cycling Tofali 4") can legitimately exceed 8000 pcs/day.
_decisions_log.action_taken: trench_covers moved from 'vibro_unconfirmed' to 'vibro' with full capacity fields added. press_machine_products capacity_model note updated to stop treating 1000-8000 as a validation ceiling.
